title: Customer, service and request: verify your service desk relationships
goal: Trace a real request to its catalog items and show that renaming a customer does not create a new identity.

prerequisites.text: 1c-enterprise.a 4; A1–A2: separate infobase, catalogs, references and documents; synthetic data only.

sections.title: From a familiar situation to a checkable question
paragraphs: One customer contacts the service twice. Does that require two customer cards? Follow saved requests to one customer, change only the name and check both links. This turns a diagram into observable behaviour.

sections.title: Where to act
paragraphs: The previous ReportsV 2 fixture stores request headers but has neither Работы nor a custom explicit form. In a prepared separate copy add the table and form only through the lesson steps below. Preserve the A 4 customer note and old documents. The example and new work use different own sets; do not substitute a whole-database total for two particular numbers. Nexus stores the explanation and note; perform the actions in installed1C.

sections.title: An entity follows its lifecycle
paragraphs: A customer exists before and after individual requests; a service describes an offering; a request records an occurrence in time. Repeating customer text in each request creates duplicates and widespread edits after a name change. A catalog reference separates persistent identity from recurring operations.

Use customer Учебный A5, service Диагностика A5 and two requests of 30 and 15 minutes. Create the customer once and select the same item in both documents. The customer ← requests → service diagram shows stored reference direction, not window order: each request contains both references.

sections.title: How to carry out the worked example
paragraphs: Follow the route in your prepared own copy. This is the worked example; the new task below uses different data. Compare each expectation with your actual reread.

Step 1. Choose your module 4 copy and verify its name and directory against your notes. Open Учебная служба. Do not load a full CF over your work. Expected: Earlier customers, services and requests are visible.
Step 2. Create Учебный A5 and Диагностика A5 only if absent from your own attempt. Use Записать и закрыть, reopen and record the assigned codes. Expected: One identified customer and service exist.

Step 3. Select these items, 30 minutes and Новая in the first request; save and close. Save the second with the same items and 15 minutes. Record actual numbers and dates. Expected: Two saved requests with a 45-minute own-set control.
Step 4. Change its name to Учебный A5 — уточнено and save. Do not use Create; verify the same code. Expected: Same code, updated name.

Step 5. Reopen each request, open the linked customer using the button beside its field and compare the code. Check duration and service, then fill your observation table. Expected: Same customer and service, distinct 30/15-minute requests.

sections.title: Minimal fields must still be sufficient
paragraphs: The teaching core needs customer and service codes/names plus a document with references, date, minutes and status. Real phone numbers, addresses and identity documents are unnecessary. Associate each field with a workflow and persistence criterion; otherwise the model grows without testable benefit.

The platform assigns the item code when it is saved. Record actual codes and document numbers; C1, S1 and R1 are diagram labels only. A name is human-readable and may coincide between different records. Do not type C1 into a numeric code or rename metadata merely to match an illustration.

sections.title: Predict the result
paragraphs: Both requests display a new customer name after renaming. Is that enough to establish the original relation?

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: No. Different cards can share a name. Open the customer from each request and compare the actual code; the author check also compares the internal reference. Request numbers, minutes and other fields must remain unchanged.

sections.title: A rule connects objects
paragraphs: A request selects an existing customer and service; an enumeration supplies allowed statuses. Deleting a referenced customer is not an isolated list cleanup. Specify inactive-customer and historical-document behavior. The foundation course can use marking and reference checks without claiming an industrial archival mechanism.

Rename only your Учебный A5 item to Учебный A5 — уточнено. Save it, reopen both requests and open their linked customer. The actual code should remain unchanged. If you made a duplicate, inspect which item each request references; do not bulk-replace links or delete records to improve the appearance of a report.

paragraphs: Read the path and explain what changes at each step. The diagram does not operate the external application.

sections.title: Check the explanation’s boundary
paragraphs: Use the second worked case only in an own copy or unsaved draft. Preserve the accepted record and explain the discrepancy.
Select your existing item and compare its actual code.

sections.title: A workflow checks cohesion
paragraphs: Follow createcustomer → createservice → createrequest → findrequest → obtaintotal. Record identity and successful reread at each step. Change the customer’s displayed name and confirm the request still references the same item. This tests model cohesion rather than merely collecting attractive screens.

Record actual document number, customer code, service code, duration, status and successful reopening. Your two-request control is 45 minutes. The entire infobase can contain more minutes from earlier lessons. Compare the same bounded set and retain those records: this begins an acceptance scenario, not evidence of a production system.

sections.title: A new independent task
paragraphs: In your own separate verified copy create one new fictional customer “Учебный перенос A 5” and two requests of 40 and 25 minutes using an existing service. Record actual codes and numbers. Rename only this card to “Учебный перенос A 5 — проверено”. Open the customer from both saved requests and compare its code, minutes and other fields. The new set totals 65 minutes; preserve earlier requests.
Record a prediction first. After your own attempt reveal the reference and compare the selected record as well as its number.

sections.title: Actual training-service window
paragraphs: Two newly restored copies in actual1C verify references after renaming, row persistence, absence of automatic recalculation, empty-header refusal, the actual named form and fresh reads. Main 9/255 and independent 9/290 include earlier 4/120. All old fields and the A 4 note persist. Two GUI captures show only their labelled forms. Manual wizard, full Tab, permissions, installer, devices and learner understanding are NOT RUN.

paragraphs: Two newly restored copies in actual1C verify references after renaming, row persistence, absence of automatic recalculation, empty-header refusal, the actual named form and fresh reads. Main 9/255 and independent 9/290 include earlier 4/120. All old fields and the A 4 note persist. Two GUI captures show only their labelled forms. Manual wizard, full Tab, permissions, installer, devices and learner understanding are NOT RUN.
Technical checks do not assess understanding. Distinguish your observations from unperformed steps. Training names, numbers and comments are fictional; no work data is required.

selfcheck.prompt: Both requests display a new customer name after renaming. Is that enough to establish the original relation?
selfcheck.feedback: No. Different cards can share a name. Open the customer from each request and compare the actual code; the author check also compares the internal reference. Request numbers, minutes and other fields must remain unchanged.

selfcheck.prompt: Another request for the same customer needs
selfcheck.feedback: The requests differ; their customer is shared.

selfcheck.prompt: How do you distinguish equal names?
options: Open the cards and compare codes/references
selfcheck.feedback: Position and name do not establish identity.

selfcheck.prompt: After renaming the new customer 40+25 equals…
options: 65, with the same two customer references
selfcheck.feedback: One customer card participates in two distinct requests. After renaming, both request numbers open the same previous customer code; service and other fields remain unchanged. New minutes 40+25=65 belong to the two contacts rather than a customer property. An overall report may include previous work; do not present it as the total of only these two numbers. Similar names without matching codes do not establish the relation.
